dedupe_keys.name: experimental dataset for time multiplexed round robin exit allocation in a controlled pedestrian evacuation experiment

description: Gustavo Paramés-Lasheras and colleagues publish pedestrian trajectories from a controlled experiment on time-multiplexed exit recommendations. Zenodo provides a trajectories CSV and short README under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. An ultra-wideband tracking platform recorded experiment, strategy, repetition, pseudonymous participant, timestamp, x and y position, recommended exit and final exit. The cleaned paths can calibrate movement speeds or test how an exit-allocation strategy affects evacuation routing in a building simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this experiment. A limitation is that the own page does not give participant count, building geometry or a direct estimate of behaviour in an actual emergency. Assigned exits can be missing when no recommendation was issued. The coordinates and time strings were not downloaded or plotted, and tracking accuracy and experimental effects were not checked.
